title: Qwen3.6-27B · Diverging Universes
subtitle: Choose one canonical BF16/Triton hardware run as the starting point, add valid single-axis comparisons, and replay each measured fork into its retained 100-token counterfactual future.
method: Every next-token result uses the identical recorded prefix. Cross-hardware choices hold Triton attention, BF16 weights, and BF16 key/value cache fixed. Same-hardware choices change the named attention, weight, or key/value-cache coordinate.

comparison_policy.name: Frozen P0/P1 publication matrix
comparison_policy.summary: Cross-hardware comparisons change only the platform/runtime coordinate. Same-hardware comparisons change one named attention or precision coordinate. P2 diagnostics are excluded.
limitations: A measured Top-1 disagreement is a fork root, not proof that either winner is objectively correct.
Length-limited 100-token branches are incomplete/indecisive, not failures.
Generated tool calls were structurally inspected but never executed.
SM121 has one-step logits in this release, but no matching P0/P1 recursive branch capture.

tie_rules.argmax: Sampler argmax: the first token ID at the maximal logit, aligned with the current comparator and greedy sampler.
tie_rules.legacy-topk: Published legacy top-k: reproduces the winner selection used by the earlier replay artifacts at exact BF16 ties.
